purpose: test whether predictive skill measured against a pooled baseline falsely attributes layer identity to context information transfer, and whether a layer-conditioned additive score decomposition removes that failure
primary_claim_if_supported: Predictive skill is not equivalent to transfer of the claimed information: when outcomes differ among layers, skill against a pooled reference can be credited to context even when the true within-layer context effect is zero; conditioning the reference on layer separates layer identity from within-layer context transfer.

relationship_to_odsp.odsp_role: implementation of held-out score accounting and population-level transfer summaries

prerequisites.population_mean_decision_rule: 95% interval for the equal-weight mean across independent groups; declare positive transfer only when the lower bound is greater than zero
prerequisites.reason_population_cluster_not_used: layer is a fixed simulated design factor; the stage-1 estimand is the equal-weight mean across the finite designed mix of independent groups, not a superpopulation of random layers

data_generating_process.linear_predictor: logit P(Y=1) = intercept + layer_effect_scale * z_layer + within_layer_context_effect * X
data_generating_process.layer_score_definition: for K layers, z_layer is equally spaced from -1 to 1, then centered and scaled to population SD 1
data_generating_process.layer_assignment: groups are allocated as evenly as possible among layers; tie allocation is deterministic from the master seed
data_generating_process.event_independence: events are conditionally independent given layer and X
data_generating_process.reason_no_group_random_effect: stage 1 isolates layer-identity confounding rather than mixing it with a second latent-group failure mode

factorial_design.factorial_result_role: mechanism map and effect-size surface; not used alone to decide the primary claim

learners.solver_contract: unpenalized maximum-likelihood logistic regression with fixed convergence tolerance and maximum iterations, identical across methods
learners.reason_audit_model_is_fit_when_focal_lea: the audit estimates context transfer conditional on layer even when the deployed or published focal learner omitted layer and allowed context to proxy it

random_row_cv.assignment: seeded row-level folds shared by all compared models within a simulated world

group_cv.assignment: whole independent groups are assigned to folds with layer-stratified round-robin allocation; no group appears in training and testing for the same fold
group_cv.minimum_training_support: the structural eligibility rule guarantees at least one training group from every layer whenever a group from that layer is held out

cross_validation.paired_comparison: all evaluation methods use the same generated world and deterministic fold assignments

score_definitions.primary_proper_score: held-out log score; larger is better
score_definitions.pooled_reference: held-out score of the intercept-only model fitted on the corresponding training fold
score_definitions.layer_conditioned_reference: held-out score of the layer-only model fitted on the corresponding training fold

population_decision_rule.interval: group percentile bootstrap with 4000 draws because no higher-level population cluster is declared in stage 1
population_decision_rule.auc_unavailable_rule: a group lacking both outcome classes has unavailable group AUC and is excluded only from the AUC diagnostic with the estimable fraction reported; no value is imputed

oracle_targets.context_transfer_truth: expected log-score gain of the true P(Y|layer,X) over true P(Y|layer)
oracle_targets.layer_transfer_truth: expected log-score gain of the true P(Y|layer) over the true pooled P(Y)

reported_outcomes_per_factorial_cell: audit context-component bias relative to oracle context transfer

central_failure_mode: A_explicit_layer_pooled_reference: lower 95% Monte Carlo bound for group_cv_pooled_log_gain false-positive rate > 0.50
B_context_proxy_for_layer: lower 95% Monte Carlo bound for group_cv_pooled_log_gain false-positive rate > 0.50
high_information_bias: F_high_information_bias_correlated: absolute mean audit context-component bias <= 0.02 nats/event
G_high_information_bias_uncorrelated: absolute mean audit context-component bias <= 0.02 nats/event
success_rules.bop_reality_check: the deterministic anchor layer gain must remain inside [0.20, 0.35] nats/event

decision_tree_after_single_execution.narrow_explicit_layer_only_paper: A and all correction validity rules pass, but B fails; remove the claim that correlated context reliably proxies omitted layer identity
decision_tree_after_single_execution.diagnostic_only_rescope: false-positive control passes but either D or E power is below 0.80; do not claim the correction preserves useful sensitivity
decision_tree_after_single_execution.central_claim_withdrawn: A fails at the BOP-calibrated layer effect, the deterministic BOP reality check fails, or the decomposed context test exceeds the null error ceiling in any primary null anchor

single_execution_governance.bug_fix_policy: a material implementation bug invalidates the affected run; fix under a new contract version and retain the invalidated receipt rather than silently rerunning v1
